path.description: Path to the file on the server

offset.description: 1-based line number to start reading from (default 1). Ignored when ranges is provided.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read starting from offset. Defaults to all remaining lines. Ignored when ranges is provided.

offset.description: 1-based line number where the range starts

limit.description: Number of lines in this range

ranges.description: One or more line ranges to read. Mutually exclusive with offset/limit.

line_numbers.description: When true, prefix each line with its 1-based line number followed by ': ' (e.g. '128: content').
